<p align="center"><strong>Moonseed collected. Recover the copper coil below.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">Moon water reaches the roots. The flower opens around a pale seed. When you lift it, every false reflection vanishes at once.</p>

<p align="center">For an instant you see the garden clearly: the pumpkins hold small, frightened lights. Beyond them stands something tall without a face. It backs away from the seed.</p>

<p align="center">A pipe descends into the cellar. Elias's notebook says the copper coil below can carry the seed's light into a protective lantern.</p>
